It gets you more performance because it has mods like Sodium, Very Many Players, Debugify, Modern Fix etc. 2. You can put shaders on it quickly because of the Iris Shaders Mod. 3. No more need to have a server to have an SMP because of the Essential Mod. ## Dependecies of the Oxygen Modpack ⭐ - Java 21 ## Troubleshooting 🪛 1. Verify your Java Version it needs to be on Java 21
